content_sections.heading: UCIL Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for UCIL Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Medical Officer post is scheduled for 02 September 2026. Candidates should report on this date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Medical Officer position in the Uranium Corporation of India (UCIL) recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree recognized by the Indian Medical Council and have relevant experience in a reputed hospital. A PG degree or AFIH qualification is an added advantage.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Medical Officer post is 65 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 80,500 to Rs. 1,20,600, depending on their experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this UCIL recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Tummalapalle, Andhra Pradesh, with the pincode 516349.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Personal Interview followed by Document Verification.
